steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ weigh two sides — advantage, disadvantage, benefit, drawback, perspective
✓ agree at two strengths — I couldn’t agree more / I suppose so
✓ disagree at two strengths — I’m not sure about that / I totally disagree
✓ keep spoken phrases out of written work, and the other way round
✓ structure an essay — On the one hand… However… On balance…
✓ write a conclusion that narrows the question instead of repeating it
